question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Ecstasy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Despair**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ecstasy"** means an overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement. (परमानंद)

 
 
• **Example: **She was in a state of **ecstasy **when she heard the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Despair"** refers to the complete loss or absence of hope. (निराशा)
 
 
• **Example: **He fell into **despair **after losing his job.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Ecstasy'** is **'Despair'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Euphoria** (आनंद): A feeling or state of intense excitement and happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** The **euphoria **of winning the championship was overwhelming.
 
 
 
• **Coarse** (अशिष्ट): Rough or harsh in texture.
 
 
• **Example:** The **coarse **fabric was uncomfortable to wear.
